Question: What is the total number of employees reporting to each manager by job title?
SQL Query: SELECT e.reportsTo, e.jobTitle, COUNT(*) AS total_employees FROM employees e GROUP BY e.reportsTo, e.jobTitle;

Question: What is the total number of orders placed by customers in each office by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, p.productLine, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o2.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, p.productLine;

Question: What is the total revenue generated by each product line by sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT e.employeeNumber, p.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total_revenue FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY e.employeeNumber, p.productLine;

Question: What is the total number of products in stock for each product line by office?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, p.productLine, SUM(p.quantityInStock) AS total_stock FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o2.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, p.productLine;

Question: What is the total number of orders placed by customers in each office by sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber;

Question: What is the total revenue generated by each customer by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerNumber, p.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS total_revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY c.customerNumber, p.productLine;

Question: What is the average order value for each product line?
SQL Query: SELECT p.productLine, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT od.productCode, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS order_value FROM orderdetails od GROUP BY od.orderNumber) AS order_values JOIN products p ON order_values.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY p.productLine;

Question: What is the total number of orders for each sales representative?

Question: What is the average order value for each sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT e.employeeNumber, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.customerNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.orderNumber) AS order_values JOIN customers c ON order_values.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber;

Question: What is the average number of products per order for each sales representative?

Question: What is the total revenue generated by each sales representative's customers?

Question: What is the total number of orders shipped by each sales representative's customers?
SQL Query: SELECT e.employeeNumber, COUNT(*) AS total_shipped_orders FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE o.shippedDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.employeeNumber;

Question: What is the average payment amount for each customer by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerNumber, p.productLine, AVG(pmt.amount) AS avg_payment FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN payments pmt ON c.customerNumber = pmt.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, p.productLine;

Question: What is the total value of payments received from each customer by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerNumber, p.productLine, SUM(pmt.amount) AS total_payment FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN payments pmt ON c.customerNumber = pmt.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, p.productLine;

Question: What is the average number of products per order by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT p.productLine, AVG(quantityOrdered) AS avg_products_per_order FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productLine;

Question: What is the average number of products ordered per sales representative?

Question: What is the total number of orders placed by customers in each office by sales representative by product line?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, p.productLine, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o2.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, p.productLine;

Question: What is the average number of orders per office for each sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, AVG(total_orders) AS avg_orders_per_office_rep FROM (SELECT customerNumber, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders GROUP BY customerNumber) AS customer_orders JOIN customers c ON customer_orders.customerNumber = c.customerNumber JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber;

Question: What is the average value of all orders placed by customers in each office by sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber JOIN (SELECT orderNumber, SUM(quantityOrdered * priceEach) AS order_value FROM orderdetails GROUP BY orderNumber) AS order_values ON o2.orderNumber = order_values.orderNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber;

Question: What is the total value of payments received from each customer by office by sales representative?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, c.customerNumber, SUM(pmt.amount) AS total_payment FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN payments pmt ON c.customerNumber = pmt.customerNumber GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, c.customerNumber;

Question: What is the total number of orders placed by customers in each office by sales representative by product line by month?
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, p.productLine, MONTH(o2.orderDate) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM offices o JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o2 ON c.customerNumber = o2.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o2.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, e.employeeNumber, p.productLine, MONTH(o2.orderDate);

Question: List all products and their corresponding product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, pl.productLine FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: Get the names and email addresses of employees who manage other employees.
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName, e1.email FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.employeeNumber = e2.reportsTo;

Question: Find the customer names and their sales representatives' names for customers who have placed orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, e1.firstName AS salesRepFirstName, e1.lastName AS salesRepLastName FROM customers c JOIN employees e1 ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e1.employeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber;

Question: Get all orders with their corresponding customer names and the cities of those customers.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, c.customerName, c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;

Question: List the product names and the quantities ordered for products ordered by a specific customer.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.customerNumber = 103;

Question: Find the total amount paid by each customer and their credit limit.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS totalPaid, c.creditLimit FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerNumber, c.creditLimit;

Question: List employees and the cities where their offices are located.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

Question: Get all orders that were shipped late, including the customer name and the order status.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, c.customerName, o.status FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.shippedDate > o.requiredDate;

Question: Find the products with prices higher than the average price of all products.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice FROM products p WHERE p.buyPrice > (SELECT AVG(buyPrice) FROM products);

Question: List customers and the products they have ordered along with the quantities ordered.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: Get the names of employees and the names of customers they handle.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName AS employeeFirstName, e.lastName AS employeeLastName, c.customerName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber;

Question: Find the order details for a specific order number along with product descriptions.
SQL Query: SELECT od.orderNumber, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered, od.priceEach, p.productDescription FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE od.orderNumber = 101;

Question: List all products that are in stock and their respective product lines and descriptions.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.quantityInStock, pl.productLine, pl.textDescription FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine WHERE p.quantityInStock > 0;

Question: Get the total sales amount for each product line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSales FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find employees who report to more than one manager (if applicable).
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber GROUP BY e1.employeeNumber HAVING COUNT(e2.reportsTo) > 1;

Question: Get all customers who have made payments but have not placed any orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber LEFT JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE o.orderNumber IS NULL AND p.checkNumber IS NOT NULL;

Question: List all orders, including customer names and their addresses, for orders that have been shipped.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, c.customerName, c.addressLine1, c.addressLine2 FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber WHERE o.shippedDate IS NOT NULL;

Question: Find all employees with their respective office cities and phone numbers who do not manage anyone.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city, o.phone FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE e.employeeNumber NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT reportsTo FROM employees);

Question: List all products with their descriptions and images from product lines that have more than 5 products.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.productDescription, pl.textDescription FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine GROUP BY p.productLine HAVING COUNT(p.productCode) > 5;

Question: Get the total number of orders and total amount for each customer.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS totalOrders, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Find the top 5 products by quantity ordered in the last 30 days.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalQuantityOrdered FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.orderDate > CURDATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY p.productName ORDER BY totalQuantityOrdered DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: List all customers with their contact details and the names of the employees handling their sales.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName, e.firstName AS salesRepFirstName, e.lastName AS salesRepLastName FROM customers c LEFT JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber;

Question: Find the average payment amount for each customer and list their names and credit limits.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, AVG(p.amount) AS averagePayment, c.creditLimit FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName, c.creditLimit;

Question: Get all employees who work in the same city as their office.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode WHERE o.city = (SELECT city FROM offices WHERE officeCode = e.officeCode);

Question: Find products that have not been ordered yet, including their product line and descriptions.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, pl.productLine, p.productDescription FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine WHERE od.orderNumber IS NULL;

Question: List the top 3 cities with the most employees working in them and the count of employees in those cities.
SQL Query: SELECT o.city, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employeeCount FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.city ORDER BY employeeCount DESC LIMIT 3;

Question: Get the total revenue for each product line, including the product line name and the total revenue amount.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find the employees who report to a manager with a specific job title and list their names and job titles.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.jobTitle FROM employees e JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber WHERE m.jobTitle = 'Sales Manager';

Question: List all customers who have ordered products in a specific product line and the names of the products they ordered.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.productLine = 'Classic Cars';

Question: Get the employees who work in the same office as their manager and list their names and office codes.
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName, e1.officeCode FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE e1.officeCode = e2.officeCode;

Question: Find the departments with the highest number of employees, including office location details.
SQL Query: SELECT o.territory, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employeeCount FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.territory ORDER BY employeeCount DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: List the product lines with the highest average buy price and their descriptions.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, AVG(p.buyPrice) AS averageBuyPrice, pl.textDescription FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine GROUP BY pl.productLine ORDER BY averageBuyPrice DESC;

Question: Find the names of customers who have made the highest total payments and the amount of their total payments.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS totalPayments FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY totalPayments DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Get all the products with their names and prices, including their descriptions, for orders that have been shipped.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice, p.productDescription FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.shippedDate IS NOT NULL;

Question: Find the total number of products ordered and the total amount spent on each product code.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productCode, p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalQuantityOrdered, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmountSpent FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productCode;

Question: List the names of employees and their managers who have the same job title.
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName AS employeeFirstName, e1.lastName AS employeeLastName, e2.firstName AS managerFirstName, e2.lastName AS managerLastName FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE e1.jobTitle = e2.jobTitle;

Question: Find customers who have ordered more than 3 different products, including the names and order numbers.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.productCode) AS uniqueProductsOrdered, o.orderNumber FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName, o.orderNumber HAVING uniqueProductsOrdered > 3;

Question: Get the details of all employees who work in offices located in the same city as their customers.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN customers c ON o.city = c.city;

Question: Find the most recent order date for each customer and the total amount spent on those orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, MAX(o.orderDate) AS mostRecentOrderDate, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmountSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: List all products that have a buy price greater than the average price of products in their respective product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice FROM products p JOIN (SELECT productLine, AVG(buyPrice) AS avgPrice FROM products GROUP BY productLine) avg_prices ON p.productLine = avg_prices.productLine WHERE p.buyPrice > avg_prices.avgPrice;

Question: Find customers with the highest credit limit who have not made any payments yet.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, c.creditLimit FROM customers c LEFT JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber WHERE p.checkNumber IS NULL ORDER BY c.creditLimit DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Get the average number of orders placed by each customer and their credit limits.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, AVG(order_count) AS avgOrders, c.creditLimit FROM (SELECT customerNumber, COUNT(orderNumber) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY customerNumber) order_counts JOIN customers c ON order_counts.customerNumber = c.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName, c.creditLimit;

Question: List all employees and the names of customers they have sold to, along with the products sold.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, c.customerName, p.productName FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: Find the top 5 customers who have spent the most on products and list the products they purchased.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY c.customerName, p.productName ORDER BY totalSpent DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: Get the number of employees in each office and the office details.
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, o.city, o.country, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employeeCount FROM offices o LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, o.city, o.country;

Question: Find all products with prices lower than the average price in their product line and list their names and prices.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice FROM products p JOIN (SELECT productLine, AVG(buyPrice) AS avgPrice FROM products GROUP BY productLine) avg_prices ON p.productLine = avg_prices.productLine WHERE p.buyPrice < avg_prices.avgPrice;

Question: List the names of customers who have placed more than 5 orders and the total amount of these orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS totalOrders, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName HAVING totalOrders > 5;

Question: Find the products with the highest buy price and the names of their respective product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice, pl.productLine FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine WHERE p.buyPrice = (SELECT MAX(buyPrice) FROM products);

Question: Get the names of customers who have purchased products from a specific vendor and list the product names they purchased.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.productVendor = 'Sony';

Question: List all employees with their managers and the number of orders handled by each employee.
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName AS employeeFirstName, e1.lastName AS employeeLastName, e2.firstName AS managerFirstName, e2.lastName AS managerLastName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS ordersHandled FROM employees e1 LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber LEFT JOIN customers c ON e1.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY e1.employeeNumber, e2.employeeNumber;

Question: Find customers who have placed orders with a status of 'Shipped' and the names of the products ordered.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.productName FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE o.status = 'Shipped';

Question: Get the total amount spent on products ordered by each customer and list the top 10 customers by amount spent.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY totalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;

Question: List the names and contact details of employees who have no direct reports.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.email FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.employeeNumber = m.reportsTo WHERE m.employeeNumber IS NULL;

Question: Find all products that are out of stock and the product lines they belong to.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, pl.productLine FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine WHERE p.quantityInStock = 0;

Question: Get the total revenue for each product line and the total quantity ordered for each product in that line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalQuantityOrdered FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY pl.productLine, p.productName;

Question: Find the top 3 products with the highest number of orders and list their product codes and names.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productCode, p.productName, COUNT(od.orderNumber) AS orderCount FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productCode, p.productName ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3;

Question: List all customers and their orders, including the order dates and statuses, who are located in the same city as their office.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, o.orderDate, o.status FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN offices off ON c.city = off.city;

Question: Find the names and descriptions of products that have been ordered more than 10 times, including their product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.productDescription, pl.productLine FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine GROUP BY p.productName, p.productDescription HAVING COUNT(od.orderNumber) > 10;

Question: Get the total number of products ordered by each customer and list their names and total products ordered.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalProductsOrdered FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Find employees who have the highest number of reports and list their names and number of reports.
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName, COUNT(e2.employeeNumber) AS numReports FROM employees e1 LEFT JOIN employees e2 ON e1.employeeNumber = e2.reportsTo GROUP BY e1.employeeNumber ORDER BY numReports DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: List all orders, including the product names and the total amount for each order, for orders placed by a specific customer.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach AS totalAmount FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE o.customerNumber = 101;

Question: Get the total number of payments made by each customer and list their names and payment counts.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(p.checkNumber) AS paymentCount FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Find the top 5 products with the lowest quantity in stock and list their product names and quantities.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.quantityInStock FROM products p ORDER BY p.quantityInStock ASC LIMIT 5;

Question: List the names of employees who have handled more than 10 orders and the total number of orders they handled.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS orderCount FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber HAVING orderCount > 10;

Question: Find the average amount spent on orders by customers with credit limits above $5000.
SQL Query: SELECT AVG(totalSpent) AS avgAmountSpent FROM (SELECT c.customerName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber WHERE c.creditLimit > 5000 GROUP BY c.customerName) total_spent;

Question: Get the details of all products that have a quantity in stock less than 5 and list their names and quantities.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.quantityInStock FROM products p WHERE p.quantityInStock < 5;

Question: List the names of customers who have made payments of more than $1000 and the total amount of their payments.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS totalPayments FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName HAVING totalPayments > 1000;

Question: Find the total number of orders placed by each customer and list their names and total orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS totalOrders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Get the details of employees and their offices who have sold products with a price greater than $1000.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city, o.country FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode WHERE p.buyPrice > 1000;

Question: Find all products that have never been ordered and list their product names and product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, pl.productLine FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode WHERE od.orderNumber IS NULL JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: List the top 5 customers with the highest credit limit and their contact details.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, c.contactFirstName, c.contactLastName, c.creditLimit FROM customers c ORDER BY c.creditLimit DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: Get the number of orders with the status 'Shipped' and the total amount of these orders.
SQL Query: SELECT COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS shippedOrdersCount, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalShippedAmount FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber WHERE o.status = 'Shipped';

Question: Find the names of employees who have no direct reports and list their names and job titles.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.jobTitle FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.employeeNumber = m.reportsTo WHERE m.employeeNumber IS NULL;

Question: List all orders and their status along with the names of the products ordered for each order.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, o.status, p.productName FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: Get the total number of products ordered in each product line and list their names and quantities.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalQuantityOrdered FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY pl.productLine, p.productName;

Question: Find the names and emails of employees who work in offices located in the same state as their customers.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.email FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode JOIN customers c ON o.state = c.state;

Question: List the names of customers who have ordered products from more than 2 different product lines.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY c.customerName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.productLine) > 2;

Question: Get the average number of products ordered per order for each product line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, AVG(order_count) AS avgProductsOrderedPerOrder FROM (SELECT p.productLine, o.orderNumber, COUNT(od.productCode) AS order_count FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber GROUP BY p.productLine, o.orderNumber) order_counts GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find the names and contact details of employees who handle customers with the highest total payments.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.email FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber HAVING SUM(p.amount) = (SELECT MAX(totalPayments) FROM (SELECT e2.employeeNumber, SUM(p.amount) AS totalPayments FROM employees e2 JOIN customers c2 ON e2.employeeNumber = c2.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN payments p ON c2.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY e2.employeeNumber) total_per_employee);

Question: List all orders with their statuses and the names of products ordered, including the total amount for each order.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, o.status, p.productName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmount FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode GROUP BY o.orderNumber, o.status, p.productName;

Question: Get the names and emails of employees who have handled the most orders.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, e.email FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber ORDER BY COUNT(o.orderNumber) DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Find the total number of unique products ordered by each customer.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.productCode) AS uniqueProductsOrdered FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: List the top 5 most expensive products and their prices.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice FROM products p ORDER BY p.buyPrice DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: Get the average quantity ordered per order for each product line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, AVG(order_count) AS avgQuantityOrderedPerOrder FROM (SELECT p.productLine, o.orderNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS order_count FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber GROUP BY p.productLine, o.orderNumber) order_counts GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find the total revenue generated from orders in each city.
SQL Query: SELECT o.city, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.city;

Question: List the names of employees who have the highest total sales and the number of orders they have handled.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSales, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS orderCount FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber ORDER BY totalSales DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Find the average payment amount made by each customer.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, AVG(p.amount) AS avgPaymentAmount FROM customers c JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: List all products that have been ordered but not yet shipped.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber WHERE o.shippedDate IS NULL;

Question: Get the total number of products ordered for each product line and the total revenue for each line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalQuantityOrdered, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find the top 10 customers with the most orders and list their names and the total number of orders they have placed.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS totalOrders FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY totalOrders DESC LIMIT 10;

Question: List the names and total amount spent on orders by each customer who has made payments.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Find the top 5 customers with the highest number of different products ordered and list their names and number of unique products.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.productCode) AS uniqueProductsOrdered FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY uniqueProductsOrdered DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: List all orders along with the number of products ordered and the total amount for each order.
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, COUNT(od.productCode) AS productCount, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalAmount FROM orders o JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY o.orderNumber;

Question: Get the names and prices of products with the highest and lowest prices.
SQL Query: SELECT MAX(buyPrice) AS highestPrice, MIN(buyPrice) AS lowestPrice FROM products;

Question: Find the names of employees who have sold products to the most number of unique customers.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customerNumber) AS uniqueCustomersServed FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber ORDER BY uniqueCustomersServed DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Get the total revenue generated from orders by each employee.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber;

Question: Find the top 3 products that have been ordered the most and list their names and order counts.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, COUNT(od.orderNumber) AS orderCount FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productName ORDER BY orderCount DESC LIMIT 3;

Question: List the names of employees who have handled the highest total revenue from orders and the number of orders handled.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS orderCount FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Get the average revenue per order for each product line.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, AVG(order_total) AS avgRevenuePerOrder FROM (SELECT p.productLine, o.orderNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS order_total FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber GROUP BY p.productLine, o.orderNumber) order_totals GROUP BY pl.productLine;

Question: Find the total revenue generated by each vendor.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productVendor, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM products p JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY p.productVendor;

Question: Get the average amount spent by each customer on orders and list the top 10 customers by average amount spent.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, AVG(totalSpent) AS avgAmountSpent FROM (SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalSpent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName, o.orderNumber) order_totals GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY avgAmountSpent DESC LIMIT 10;

Question: List all products with a price between $500 and $1000 and their quantities in stock.
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.buyPrice, p.quantityInStock FROM products p WHERE p.buyPrice BETWEEN 500 AND 1000;

Question: Find the names of customers who have made payments but have not placed any orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber WHERE o.orderNumber IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber);

Question: Get the total number of orders placed by each customer and the average order amount for those orders.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS totalOrders, AVG(order_amount) AS avgOrderAmount FROM (SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS order_amount FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName, o.orderNumber) order_totals GROUP BY c.customerName;

Question: Find the total revenue generated from orders with a status of 'Shipped' and list the top 5 customers by revenue.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber WHERE o.status = 'Shipped' GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY totalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: Get the total number of products ordered from each product line and list the top 5 product lines by total products ordered.
SQL Query: SELECT pl.productLine, SUM(od.quantityOrdered) AS totalProductsOrdered FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode GROUP BY pl.productLine ORDER BY totalProductsOrdered DESC LIMIT 5;

Question: List all employees and the total revenue generated by their customers' orders.
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, SUM(od.quantityOrdered * od.priceEach) AS totalRevenue FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber;

Question: Find the names of customers who have ordered the highest number of products and list their total product count.
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(od.productCode) AS totalProductsOrdered FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY totalProductsOrdered DESC LIMIT 1;

Question: Find all products and their corresponding product lines including their descriptions
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, pl.textDescription FROM products p INNER JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: List all employees and their offices including phone numbers, even if they don't have an office assigned
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city, o.phone FROM employees e LEFT JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

Question: Find all customers and their orders, including those customers who haven't placed any orders
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber;

Question: Get all orders and their corresponding order details with product names
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, od.productCode, p.productName FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber INNER JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: List all employees and the customers they have sold to, including those who have not sold to any customer
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, c.customerName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber;

Question: Find all payments and the customers who made them, including customers with no payments
SQL Query: SELECT p.checkNumber, p.paymentDate, c.customerName FROM payments p LEFT JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;

Question: Get all orders and the corresponding payment details
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, p.checkNumber, p.paymentDate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: List all products and their corresponding order details, including products with no order details
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, od.quantityOrdered FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode;

Question: Find all customers and their orders along with the corresponding order details
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, od.productCode FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber INNER JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber;

Question: List all offices and the employees assigned to them, including offices with no employees assigned
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, o.city, e.firstName, e.lastName FROM offices o LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode;

Question: Find all products and their descriptions, including products with no descriptions
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, p.productDescription, pl.textDescription FROM products p LEFT JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: Get the names of customers who have made payments, along with the payment details
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, p.checkNumber, p.paymentDate FROM customers c INNER JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: List all products and the offices where they are available, including products with no associated offices
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, o.city FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber;

Question: Find all orders and their details, including orders with no details
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, od.productCode, od.quantityOrdered FROM orders o LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber;

Question: List all employees and their managers, including employees without managers
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName AS Employee, m.firstName AS Manager FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber;

Question: Find all orders and their payments, including orders with no payments
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, p.checkNumber, p.paymentDate FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: Get all products and their sales representatives, including products without sales representatives
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, e.firstName, e.lastName FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.customerNumber = e.employeeNumber;

Question: List all employees and their office locations, including employees with no office location
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e LEFT JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

Question: Find all customers and their orders with their payment details
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, p.checkNumber FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber LEFT JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: List all orders and their corresponding products with product descriptions
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, p.productName, p.productDescription FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber INNER JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: Get all employees and their customers, including employees who have no customers
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, c.customerName FROM employees e LEFT JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber;

Question: Find all products and their corresponding orders and customers, including products with no orders
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, o.orderNumber, c.customerName FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber LEFT JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;

Question: List all offices and the employees located in them, including offices with no employees
SQL Query: SELECT o.officeCode, o.city, e.firstName FROM offices o LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.officeCode = e.officeCode;

Question: Find all products and their corresponding customers and payments, including products with no payments
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, c.customerName, p.paymentDate FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber LEFT JOIN payments p ON o.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: Get all customers and their orders, including customers with no orders
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber;

Question: List all employees and their offices, including employees with no office
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e LEFT JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

Question: Find all products and their suppliers, including products with no suppliers
SQL Query: SELECT p.productName, e.firstName AS Supplier FROM products p LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON p.productCode = od.productCode LEFT JOIN orders o ON od.orderNumber = o.orderNumber LEFT JOIN employees e ON o.customerNumber = e.employeeNumber;

Question: Get all customers and their orders including the payment details, even if there is no payment made
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, p.checkNumber FROM customers c INNER JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber LEFT JOIN payments p ON c.customerNumber = p.customerNumber;

Question: Find all employees and their managers, including employees with no managers assigned
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName AS Employee, m.firstName AS Manager FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber;

Question: List all orders with their products and product lines, including orders with no associated product lines
SQL Query: SELECT o.orderNumber, p.productName, pl.textDescription FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber INNER JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode LEFT JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: Find all employees and their office locations, including offices with no employees
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e LEFT JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;

Question: Get all customers and their orders along with product details, including customers with no orders
SQL Query: SELECT c.customerName, o.orderNumber, p.productName FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber LEFT JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber LEFT JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: List all products and their orders, including products with no orders

SQL Query: SELECT productLine, textDescription FROM productlines WHERE productLine NOT IN (SELECT productLine FROM products WHERE MSRP > 500);

Question: Get the names of customers who have ordered products from more than 3 different product lines
SQL Query: SELECT customerName FROM customers WHERE customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM orders JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode GROUP BY customerNumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT productLine) > 3);

Question: Find the highest priced product in each product line
SQL Query: SELECT productLine, MAX(MSRP) as highest_price FROM products GROUP BY productLine;

Question: Get the total number of orders and total amount spent by each customer

Question: Find employees who work in the same office as an employee with the job title 'Sales Manager'
SQL Query: SELECT firstName, lastName FROM employees WHERE officeCode = (SELECT officeCode FROM employees WHERE jobTitle = 'Sales Manager');

Question: List the product names and their corresponding product lines for products ordered by customers in 'USA'
SQL Query: SELECT DISTINCT productName, productLine FROM products JOIN orderdetails ON products.productCode = orderdetails.productCode JOIN orders ON orderdetails.orderNumber = orders.orderNumber JOIN customers ON orders.customerNumber = customers.customerNumber WHERE customers.country = 'USA';

Question: Find the average buy price of products in each product line where the total quantity ordered is above the average quantity ordered for all products
SQL Query: SELECT productLine, AVG(buyPrice) as avg_buyPrice FROM products WHERE productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM orderdetails GROUP BY productCode HAVING SUM(quantityOrdered) > (SELECT AVG(quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails)) GROUP BY productLine;

Question: Get the names of customers who have placed orders with comments longer than 50 characters
SQL Query: SELECT customerName FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber WHERE LENGTH(comments) > 50;

SQL Query: SELECT productLine FROM productlines WHERE productLine NOT IN (SELECT productLine FROM products WHERE MSRP <= 30);

SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName as EmployeeFirstName, e1.lastName as EmployeeLastName, e2.firstName as ManagerFirstName, e2.lastName as ManagerLastName FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE e2.lastName LIKE 'S%';

Question: Get the average payment amount for customers grouped by their state
SQL Query: SELECT state, AVG(amount) as avg_payment FROM customers JOIN payments ON customers.customerNumber = payments.customerNumber GROUP BY state;

Question: Find the highest quantity ordered for any product in orders where the product code is not in the top 5 most ordered products

Question: List the names of customers who have placed orders but have not made any payments
SQL Query: SELECT customerName FROM customers WHERE customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM orders) AND customerNumber NOT IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM payments);

Question: Find the total sales amount for each employee where the total sales amount is more than the average sales amount for all employees
SQL Query: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, SUM(od.priceEach * od.quantityOrdered) as total_sales FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber HAVING SUM(od.priceEach * od.quantityOrdered) > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT SUM(od.priceEach * od.quantityOrdered) as total_sales FROM employees e JOIN customers c ON e.employeeNumber = c.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders o ON c.customerNumber = o.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails od ON o.orderNumber = od.orderNumber GROUP BY e.employeeNumber) as sales_avg);

Question: Get the names of customers who have ordered products with a buy price greater than the average buy price

SQL Query: SELECT productName FROM products WHERE productCode NOT IN (SELECT productCode FROM orderdetails JOIN orders ON orderdetails.orderNumber = orders.orderNumber JOIN customers ON orders.customerNumber = customers.customerNumber WHERE customers.country = 'USA');

SQL Query: SELECT customerName FROM customers WHERE customerNumber IN (SELECT customerNumber FROM orders JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode GROUP BY customerNumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT productLine) = 1);

SQL Query: SELECT productName, productDescription FROM products WHERE MSRP > (SELECT MEDIAN(MSRP) FROM products);

Question: Find the employees who have made sales but not in the last 6 months

Question: List all product lines where the average MSRP of products is higher than the highest MSRP in the 'Technology' product line

SQL Query: SELECT * FROM department WHERE Ranking = (SELECT MAX(Ranking) FROM department WHERE Department_ID IN (SELECT department_ID FROM management WHERE head_ID IN (SELECT head_ID FROM head WHERE age < 35)));

Question: List all orders that have comments containing the word 'Urgent' but where the shipped date is NULL
SQL Query: SELECT orderNumber, comments FROM orders WHERE comments LIKE '%Urgent%' AND shippedDate IS NULL;

Question: Get the total number of orders and the total amount of payments made by customers from each state

Question: List all employees who report to a manager with more than 10 subordinates
SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE e2.employeeNumber IN (SELECT reportsTo FROM employees GROUP BY reportsTo HAVING COUNT(employeeNumber) > 10);

Question: Find the names of customers who have ordered products that are priced below the median price and have made payments in the last 6 months
SQL Query: SELECT DISTINCT customerName FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode JOIN payments ON customers.customerNumber = payments.customerNumber WHERE MSRP < (SELECT MEDIAN(MSRP) FROM products) AND paymentDate > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH);

Question: Get the total amount spent by each customer on products from the 'Accessories' product line
SQL Query: SELECT customerName, SUM(priceEach * quantityOrdered) as total_spent FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode WHERE productLine = 'Accessories' GROUP BY customerName;

Question: List all products where the total quantity ordered is less than the average quantity ordered for all products

Question: Get the names of employees who work in offices where the number of employees is less than the average number of employees per office

Question: List all customers who have ordered products from more than one product line

Question: List the total quantity ordered for each product and the number of orders where the quantity ordered is greater than 50

SQL Query: SELECT officeCode, productCode, SUM(priceEach * quantityOrdered) as total_sales FROM employees JOIN customers ON employees.employeeNumber = customers.salesRepEmployeeNumber JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber GROUP BY officeCode, productCode ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 1;

SQL Query: SELECT customerName, SUM(amount) as total_payment FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode GROUP BY customerName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT productLine) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT productLine) FROM products);

Question: List all employees who work in offices where the number of employees is greater than the average number of employees per office

SQL Query: SELECT e1.firstName, e1.lastName FROM employees e1 JOIN employees e2 ON e1.reportsTo = e2.employeeNumber WHERE e2.jobTitle = 'Sales' AND e2.employeeNumber IN (SELECT reportsTo FROM employees GROUP BY reportsTo HAVING COUNT(employeeNumber) < 5);

Question: Find the total quantity ordered for each product in the 'Clothing' product line
SQL Query: SELECT productCode, SUM(quantityOrdered) as total_quantity FROM orderdetails JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode WHERE productLine = 'Clothing' GROUP BY productCode;

Question: Find the employees who have ordered more products than the median quantity ordered per order

SQL Query: SELECT customerName FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode GROUP BY customerName HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT productLine) > 2;

Question: Get the names of employees who work in offices with the highest number of employees

Question: List all products where the MSRP is greater than the median MSRP of their product line

Question: Find the total payment amount made by customers who have ordered from both 'Furniture' and 'Technology' product lines
SQL Query: SELECT SUM(amount) as total_payment FROM payments JOIN customers ON payments.customerNumber = customers.customerNumber JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode WHERE productLine IN ('Furniture', 'Technology');

SQL Query: SELECT productLine, AVG(product_count) as avg_products FROM (SELECT productLine, customerNumber, COUNT(productCode) as product_count FROM customers JOIN orders ON customers.customerNumber = orders.customerNumber JOIN orderdetails ON orders.orderNumber = orderdetails.orderNumber GROUP BY productLine, customerNumber) as product_counts GROUP BY productLine;

Question: List all products where the quantity ordered is more than the average quantity ordered for their product line
SQL Query: SELECT productName FROM products WHERE productCode IN (SELECT productCode FROM orderdetails JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode GROUP BY productCode HAVING SUM(quantityOrdered) > (SELECT AVG(quantityOrdered) FROM orderdetails JOIN products ON orderdetails.productCode = products.productCode WHERE products.productLine = products.productLine));
